name: tuntas-agent
description: Deterministic proof-of-done contracts and evidence receipts for AI agents.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tuntas/core build && pnpm --filter @tuntas/runner build && pnpm --filter @tuntas/cli build && pnpm --filter @tuntas/studio build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.build.json packages/runner/tsconfig.build.json packages/cli/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p apps/studio/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.pretuntas: pnpm --filter @tuntas/core build && pnpm --filter @tuntas/runner build && pnpm --filter @tuntas/cli build
